subject.title: feat(irc): support markdown messages via draft/multiline

question: Should bundled IRC adopt draft/multiline after the protocol defects are fixed, or should this remain out of core until an IRC owner sponsors the draft extension?
rationale: The PR adds a new draft IRCv3 delivery mode and changes compatibility-sensitive IRC message handling; code fixes are necessary, but accepting the draft extension is a maintainer product and ownership choice.

options.title: Repair and reconsider
options.body: Ask for a rebase plus protocol-complete repair, then reconsider the feature after focused tests and raw CAP/BATCH proof are present.

options.title: Narrow outbound first
options.body: Sponsor only outbound multiline sends first and defer inbound BATCH reconstruction until concat and limit behavior are fully designed.

options.title: Pause draft adoption
options.body: Close or pause this PR if bundled IRC should not ship draft/multiline until the extension stabilizes or a channel owner takes it on.

recommendation.title: Repair and reconsider
recommendation.body: Ask for a rebase plus protocol-complete repair, then reconsider the feature after focused tests and raw CAP/BATCH proof are present.

likelyOwner.reason: They have direct IRC feature and regression-fix history, making them the best available owner signal for accepting new bundled IRC protocol behavior.
